svg.title: Exchange argument: swapping toward shortest-first
svg.desc: Timeline 0 to 10 minutes. Given order 4,1,3,2: starts 0,4,5,8, total 17. After swapping the first pair, order 1,4,3,2: starts 0,1,5,8, total 14, a change of 1 - 4 = -3. Sorted order 1,2,3,4: starts 0,1,3,6, total 10, the brute-force minimum.
svg.text: jobs [4, 1, 3, 2] min, one machine · total = sum of start times
the swapped pair still spans minutes 0-5
